gate.name: Hangar AI Constitution Gate
gate.description: Canonical quality gate for all projects governed by the Hangar AI Constitution. Implements all 10 conditions across 4 classifications. See laws/engineering/agentic-feedback.md (ENG-12.x) and agent-skills/skills-by-domain/platform-engineering/skill-sonarqube-compliance-gate.md.

demo_gate_narrative.description: The gate is designed to tell a clear story across the Legacy Rescue workflow phases.
demo_gate_narrative.phase_1_expected: RED — legacy code has bugs and no test coverage. This is correct and expected. Captures the baseline failure state.
demo_gate_narrative.phases_2_to_5_expected: RED transitioning to YELLOW — coverage climbs through Phase 3, security/reliability fixes land in Phase 4, complexity drops in Phase 5. Gate may still show partial failures.
demo_gate_narrative.phase_6_expected: GREEN — ALL conditions met. This is the certification moment: the legacy codebase now meets the Hangar AI Constitution standard.
demo_gate_narrative.phase_7_expected: GREEN — Mutation hardening only; does not change gate state. Score evidenced via PIT HTML report.

changes: ADD HB-5: reliability_rating GT 1 as HARD_BLOCK (all code). Fixes demo gate narrative: coverage is N/A on first scan (no tests), so PG-1 coverage condition is skipped by SonarQube. reliability_rating is computed from static analysis alone — no tests needed. Legacy code with bugs fails this gate at Phase 1, passes GREEN after Phase 4 remediation.

ADD AA-B5: new_reliability_rating GT 1 as AA_BASELINE (new code). Ensures no new bugs are introduced in any code change — aligns with 'new code must not introduce more issues' intent of AA_BASELINE classification.
FIX Prerequisites: removed non-existent --token-path flag from provision.sh usage example. Auth is via SONAR_TOKEN or SONAR_USER/SONAR_PASSWORD env vars only.
FIX AA-B2: new_coverage threshold raised 80 → 90 to match ENG-4.6 (new code must be ≥90%, not 80%). Prior value was a direct constitutional violation.
ADD HB-4: critical_violations GT 0 as HARD_BLOCK per ENG-6.1 (NON-NEGOTIABLE). Critical-severity issues must block phase advance alongside blockers and vulnerabilities.
DOC GAP-1: ENG-4.11 mutation score not enforceable in SonarQube CE — requires Pitest + sonar-pitest plugin. Flagged as toolchain gap.
DOC GAP-2: ENG-6.6 dependency CVE scanning not enforceable in SonarQube CE — requires OWASP Dependency Check or Snyk integration. Flagged as toolchain gap.
Initial gate definition — 9 conditions across 4 classifications.

known_gaps.title: Mutation Testing
known_gaps.description: Mutation score (≥70% general, ≥85% critical paths) cannot be enforced via SonarQube CE gate conditions. Toolchain by platform: Java/Kotlin → Pitest + sonar-pitest plugin; Swift/iOS → Muter (https://github.com/muter-mutation-testing/muter, v16+). SonarQube CE does not support Swift analysis — iOS mutation score must be tracked via Muter JSON/HTML reports in CI pipeline.
known_gaps.remediation: Java/Kotlin: install sonar-pitest plugin on SonarQube server; add pitest goal to CI pipeline; add gate conditions: mutation_coverage LT 70 (PHASE_GATE), mutation_coverage LT 85 (HARD_BLOCK for critical modules). Swift/iOS: install Muter via Homebrew (brew install muter) or SPM; run 'muter run --format json --output mutation-report.json' in CI; publish score to PR comment or dashboard; enforce ≥70% gate in CI config.

known_gaps.title: Dependency CVE Scanning
known_gaps.description: Critical CVE 24h SLA cannot be enforced by SonarQube CE alone. OWASP Dependency Check or Snyk integration required.
known_gaps.remediation: Integrate OWASP Dependency Check into CI pipeline; publish results to SonarQube via sonar.dependencyCheck.reportPath; add gate condition on dependency vulnerabilities.

conditions.description: Matches the official sonarqube.aa.com 'Sonar way' gate — verified April 2026. All 4 conditions apply to new code only.

items.description: New code: zero new issues introduced
New code: test coverage must be ≥ 90% (ENG-4.6: new code threshold is 90%, not 80%)
New code: 100% of security hotspots must be reviewed

New code: must not introduce any bugs — new_reliability_rating must be A. Enforces the principle that each phase may not make the codebase worse. Complements HB-5 (all-code reliability) by blocking regressions introduced by new changes.

conditions.description: NON-NEGOTIABLE. Applies to ALL code (new + existing). A single violation in any HARD_BLOCK condition means the phase CANNOT advance. No exceptions. Citations: ENG-6.1, ENG-6.4, ENG-6.7.

items.description: ALL code: security rating must be A (1 = A)
ALL code: zero critical-severity violations (ENG-6.1 NON-NEGOTIABLE — security built in, not bolted on)

ALL code: reliability rating must be A (zero bugs). Computed from static analysis — no tests needed. Ensures Phase 1 gate is RED on legacy code with bugs, turns GREEN only after Phase 4 remediation. Rating scale: A=0 bugs, B=1 minor, C=1 major, D=1 critical, E=1 blocker.

conditions.description: Module-scoped coverage gate. Use --module-path flag or per-module scan to scope correctly. Citation: ENG-4.6.

items.description: ALL code: overall coverage must be ≥ 80% (scoped to module under scan)

conditions.description: Visible fail. Not a hard block, but MUST trend downward each session. Citation: ENG-3.1.

items.description: ALL code: duplication must be ≤ 3% (WARNING — trend downward)
